title: Understanding Box Plots
text: A box plot provides a visual summary of data through its quartiles and median. It shows the spread and skewness of the data, but not the mean.

title: Mean vs. Median
text: Remember that the mean is the average of all data points, while the median is the middle value when the data is ordered. A box plot shows the median, not the mean.
